post.description: Emails a single-use reset link (valid 30 minutes) to an active account. Always returns 202 with the same body so accounts cannot be discovered; limited per identifier and IP (429). Earlier open links for the account stop working (T29).

schema.description: Customer mobile digits, matched anywhere and ignoring spaces

must_change_password.description: True while the user has a temporary password; other routes return 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED.

identifier.description: Email address, or a mobile number (6-20 digits; formatting ignored).

phone.description: Optional mobile number for sign-in. Digits, spaces, +, -, . and parentheses; 6-20 digits. Stored as digits only and unique across all users; empty or null clears it.
Optional mobile number for sign-in. Digits, spaces, +, -, . and parentheses; 6-20 digits. Stored as digits only and unique across all users; empty or null clears it.
Optional mobile number for sign-in. Digits, spaces, +, -, . and parentheses; 6-20 digits. Stored as digits only and unique across all users; empty or null clears it.

Customer.description: Customers are identified by mobile number (contact), unique per company by digits (T33).

core_labels.description: Merge labels into the three protected core controls (date, customer mobile, customer name); never remove or retype core controls.

ProfileField.description: Config fields are selected by type; core controls are returned separately in core_fields.

ProfileFieldCreate.description: Reject reserved core keys service_date/customer_name/customer_contact (and the retired customer_no). Validate field caps, profile ownership, and config semantics server-side.

ProfileFieldPatch.description: Merge top-level properties; config replaces its whole object when provided. Validate effective type/config together. Core protection and historical type restrictions apply. Formula/field references, JSON limits and protected keys are validated against the effective persisted configuration.

items.description: Exactly one control per reserved core key. service_date and customer_contact (the customer's mobile number, used to find or add the customer) are editable; customer_name is a customer display projection. Labels come from profile core_labels.

staff_roles.description: Company role labels for profile administration; no staff identities or other master data.

out_store_enabled.description: True when at least one active service profile enables Out-Store.

form_data.description: Validate keys, types, required values and linked UUID ownership against the selected profile. On PATCH omitted keys remain unchanged; null clears optional enabled fields.
Validate keys, types, required values and linked UUID ownership against the selected profile. On PATCH omitted keys remain unchanged; null clears optional enabled fields.

ServiceRequestCreate.description: Send customer_id to use an existing customer, or customer to create one with the request.

form_data.description: Validate keys, types, required values and linked UUID ownership against the selected profile. On PATCH omitted keys remain unchanged; null clears optional enabled fields.
Validate keys, types, required values and linked UUID ownership against the selected profile. On PATCH omitted keys remain unchanged; null clears optional enabled fields.

linked_values.description: Map immutable linked field key to current labels. Preserve array order; inactive links remain visible with selectable=false. Resolve only authorized company records.

RequestHistory.description: One change to a record. field_key is a profile field key, core.status, core.service_date, core.customer_id, core.out_store (T35) or core.standby (T36). Out-Store and stand-by events carry a snapshot in new_value (see HistoryOutStoreValue and HistoryStandbyValue); a core.out_store 'changed' event also has the previous snapshot in old_value. changed_by_name is null only if the user no longer exists.

StandbyIssue.description: issued_by and returned_by are the users who lent and received the item (T36); null for issues recorded before T36.

StandbyIssueCreate.description: Optional Product Received must be in the same company. If a service request is linked, the product must also belong to its profile. Item, customer and request must be tenant-consistent.

InlineOutStore.description: Dispatch atomically with request creation. sent_date is service_date. Apply configured sent status and write initial/status history in the same transaction.

form_data.description: Validate keys, types, required values and linked UUID ownership against the selected profile. On PATCH omitted keys remain unchanged; null clears optional enabled fields.

customer.description: The customer created with this request, or null when customer_id was used.

InlineCustomer.description: New customer created in the same transaction as the service request. The customer number is allocated by the server. A contact whose digits match an existing customer is rejected with customer.contact.

CredentialDelivery.description: Whether the welcome or reset email was delivered. temporary_password is returned only when it was not (MAIL_MODE=log or SMTP failure), so the administrator can pass it on; the user must change it at first sign-in.

must_change_password.description: True while the user has a temporary password; other routes return 403 PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED.

UserCreated.description: Created user with the welcome-email outcome.

new_password.description: 10-128 characters with at least one letter and one number; must differ from the current password.
10-128 characters with at least one letter and one number.

form_data.description: Validate keys, types, required values and linked UUID ownership against the selected profile. On PATCH omitted keys remain unchanged; null clears optional enabled fields.

created_by_name.description: Name of the user who created the record.

out_store_status.description: Latest Out-Store entry: SENT while at a shop.

ServiceRequestListItem.description: Records list row with display values (T34).

ServiceRequestFacets.description: Counts for the current filters. Status counts ignore status_id/status_name/state, and creator counts ignore created_by, so every chip shows what selecting it would return.

HistoryOutStoreValue.description: core.out_store new_value/old_value. event is sent, changed or received; old_value omits event.

HistoryStandbyValue.description: core.standby new_value, written when an issue linked to the record is lent or returned. days_out is set on return.

StandbyIssueHistory.description: A stand-by issue with names and days out (T36). days_out counts to today while the item is still out.

Error.description: Error envelope. HTTP status/code mapping is documented in api-contract-draft.md.
